summary: Build a web application for Krishna Traders (wholesale supplier of hardware and GI materials—primarily GI plumbing material, GI clamps, and GI brackets) targeting construction and industrial customers.
architectural_notes: Store business contact details (phone numbers, email) in a single frontend config source so header/footer CTAs and Contact page reuse the same values.

existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing website for “Krishna Traders” that clearly communicates the business as a wholesale supplier of hardware materials and GI materials for construction and industrial customers, with primary focus on GI plumbing material, GI clamps, and GI brackets.

Add key website sections/pages: (1) Home (overview + featured categories), (2) Products/Categories (GI Plumbing Material, GI Clamps, GI Brackets, and a general Hardware Materials category), (3) About Krishna Traders, and (4) Contact/Inquiry.

Implement an Inquiry form (Contact/Inquiry page) that collects: customer name, company name (optional), phone number, email (optional), location (optional), category of interest (GI Plumbing / GI Clamps / GI Brackets / Hardware Materials), and message/requirements.
Wire the Inquiry form submission to the backend using the app’s existing actor/React Query patterns, including loading and error states.
Add a simple internal admin view/page to display submitted inquiries (read-only list with timestamps and field values).

Define and apply a coherent visual theme across the site (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a construction/industrial wholesale supplier. Avoid blue/purple as primary colors.

Add static business contact call-to-actions in the header/footer: “Call”, “Email”, and “WhatsApp” actions using placeholder contact details stored in a single configurable place in the frontend (easy to change later).
Render the generated static images (logo, hero banner, category illustrations) from frontend static assets and incorporate them into the Home and Products/Categories pages.

Increase the typography (font sizes) on the Krishna Traders Home page to improve readability and visual appearance, focusing on the hero headline, hero description text, and key section headings/subtext on the main (Home) page.

Update the site-wide business contact details to use phone numbers 9970279004 and 9921624211 and email traderskrishna682@gmail.com, and ensure both phone numbers are displayed wherever the site shows phone contact info (header/footer/contact page), while contact buttons/links remain functional.
Update the site header branding so the text “Krishna Traders” is prominently displayed at the top on all pages, using a larger font for better appearance (including on small/mobile screens).

Update the public site metadata for go-live by setting the HTML document title to "Krishna Traders" and adding a meta description suitable for a wholesale supplier of GI plumbing materials, GI clamps, GI brackets, and hardware materials.
Add basic public SEO/static files for go-live: create a `robots.txt` and a `sitemap.xml` in the frontend public assets so they are served at `/robots.txt` and `/sitemap.xml`.
Implement a user-friendly "Not Found" page/route so that unknown routes show a clear 404 message and a link back to Home.

Deploy the currently approved “Draft Version 4” of the Krishna Traders website to the production Internet Computer canister(s) and perform a go-live verification pass to confirm the public site is accessible and key pages load correctly.
